ROMsFun PS3 downloads instantly fail after finishing — UK users, did something change?
I’ve been trying to download some PS3 games from ROMsFun, specifically God of War Collection for RPCS3. The download completes normally, but as soon as it finishes, the browser shows “Download Failed”.

This never used to happen. ROMsFun always worked for me.

I’m currently in the UK, so I’m wondering if something changed recently, like ISP blocking or the site having issues.

Has anyone else in the UK had ROMsFun downloads fail right after finishing? Any idea what’s going on?
